
REMOVE-QUESTION
Remove a question from Example Mapping by index

USAGE
  fspec remove-question <workUnitId> <index>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <index> (required)
    Question index (from show-work-unit)

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Remove question at index 0
  $ fspec remove-question AUTH-001 0
  ✓ Removed question from AUTH-001

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-question
  fspec answer-question
  fspec show-work-unit
